purpose: Factual research inventory for interpreting profile-aware analysis. This is not an executable profile library, a runtime title classifier, or calibrated grind coefficients.

canonicalSnapshot.scope: Every tracked .tcl file, including hidden, manual, tea, filter, cleaning and calibration profiles. Also all 10 profile files and 6 generated D-Flow presets from the four pinned A/D-Flow submodules. Other installed or user-created profiles are outside this snapshot.

licenseReview.mainRepository: GPL-3.0 license file at pinned commit
licenseReview.submodules: No explicit license file found in the four reviewed pinned A/D-Flow submodule trees. No code, manuals or images copied into this catalog.
licenseReview.reuse: Original factual controller summaries, numeric facts, short names and source references only. Full source notes and profile implementations remain upstream.

interpretation.phases: Source advanced frame values or descriptive basic GUI stages. Durations are limits, not observed transition timestamps. Disabled zero-duration frames are retained. Smooth targets are end points, not instantaneous flat setpoints.
interpretation.roles: Manually reviewed semantic roles for these exact sources; no physiological saturation assertion. Not inferred from name alone during runtime.
interpretation.limits: An opposite limiter can dominate the nominal pump mode; load-time defaults and user edits may alter targets. Explicit source limits only are listed.
interpretation.preinfusion: Volume-count-start is a source accounting boundary, not proof of wetting, first drop or the complete semantic infusion stage. Source count may disagree with step names.
interpretation.units: Flow targets and volume exits are machine water mL/s and mL, not scale g/s and beverage grams. No density or retention conversion is assumed.
interpretation.identity: A matching title is insufficient. The saved brewed profile and recorded targets/frame IDs are authoritative; absent those, classification stays unknown.
interpretation.policy: conditional does not authorize an automatic numeric correction: it requires identical recipe context, achieved target, no dominant limiter, observed extraction window and repeatable local evidence.

families.label: Constant-pressure extraction
families.reason: At unchanged dose, yield, basket and temperature, measured extraction time can help compare resistance only while pressure is achieved and no flow limiter controls the shot.

families.label: Declining-pressure extraction
families.reason: Compare the same pressure trajectory and yield; rising flow as programmed pressure declines is not automatically channeling, and whole-shot duration is not a universal target.

families.label: Rising-pressure extraction
families.reason: Compare against the programmed pressure ramp; an increase in pressure is intentional. Use phase-aligned measurements with the same recipe.

families.label: Lever-style pressure extraction
families.reason: Infusion, pressure rise and decline have distinct purposes. Evaluate extraction at matching pressure stages and keep infusion, ratio and temperature fixed.

families.label: Lever-style extraction with flow fallback
families.reason: Pressure-led extraction can switch to a flow-limited rescue tail; whole-shot time combines different controllers. Inspect the actual reached frames and limiter engagement.

families.label: Flow-led extraction
families.reason: The controller sets water flow; resistance primarily changes pressure until a pressure limiter engages. Elapsed time alone cannot identify a grind change.

families.label: Allonge with flow-led extraction
families.reason: Long ratio and high programmed flow are recipe intent. Compare pressure response, actual beverage flow, ratio and taste; do not chase a conventional espresso duration.

families.label: Bloom then flow-led extraction
families.reason: Separate fill, low/no-flow bloom and extraction. Bloom duration or drip mass is profile-specific; extraction flow is commanded.

families.label: Dynamic bloom then pressure-led extraction
families.reason: A pressure-exit bloom intentionally changes length with resistance. Compare bloom and pressure extraction separately; total time is not a single grind-response signal.

families.label: Turbo-style pressure extraction
families.reason: Short/high-flow brewing is intended by this profile. Compare the same phase and recipe, not a universal 25-30 second target; a flow cap may override pressure.

families.label: Adaptive flow selection
families.reason: The profile scans successive flow settings and exits according to measured flow. Grind can change the selected operating point; compare reached frames and achieved targets.

families.label: Adaptive mixed pressure and flow
families.reason: Measured exits, pressurization and flow ramps couple timing to controller response. Compare phase-specific targets and traces, not a global time error.

families.label: A-Flow mixed pressure and flow
families.reason: Fill and weight-ended infusion precede optional pressure rise/decline and a flow ramp. Inspect enabled steps and pressure cap; designer dial-in advice is not a validated universal model.

families.label: D-Flow pressure infusion then flow pour
families.reason: Pressure fill/infusion precedes flow pouring with a pressure ceiling. Infusion exit and pouring flow are separate knobs; total time alone does not justify grind adjustment.

families.label: Manual group-head control
families.reason: The operator changes targets during brewing. A saved starting profile does not describe the actual control trajectory.

families.label: Tea or filter-style beverage
families.reason: Espresso grind/time advice does not apply; use beverage-specific recipes and basket or brewer context.

families.label: Cleaning, calibration or steam-only setup
families.reason: This is not an espresso extraction and must not enter espresso recommendation history.

families.label: Unreviewed or unidentifiable profile
families.reason: Show measured traces and targets but do not infer family or a grind adjustment from a title.
